RY-L04-S01-A01.title: Yang Energy
RY-L04-S01-A01.description: Working with the active, warming aspect of energy.
RY-L04-S01-A01.effect: Intended to add mobility and functional activity.

RY-L04-S01-A02.title: Yin Energy
RY-L04-S01-A02.description: Working with the nourishing and moistening aspect of energy.
RY-L04-S01-A02.effect: Intended to restore inner foundation and resource.

RY-L04-S01-A03.title: Yang Organs
RY-L04-S01-A03.description: Working with yang organs according to the Wu Xing model used by the course.
RY-L04-S01-A03.effect: Intended to balance active body functions in the source framework.

RY-L04-S01-A04.title: Yin Organs
RY-L04-S01-A04.description: Working with yin organs according to the Wu Xing model.
RY-L04-S01-A04.effect: Intended to strengthen inner support and nourishment.

RY-L04-S01-A05.title: Qi Activation
RY-L04-S01-A05.description: Activating and strengthening the movement of vital energy.
RY-L04-S01-A05.effect: Intended to build energy and increase a sense of mobility.

RY-L04-S01-A06.title: Wind
RY-L04-S01-A06.description: Working with Wind energy as a factor of movement.
RY-L04-S01-A06.effect: Intended to harmonise dynamics and changeability.

RY-L04-S01-A07.title: Heat
RY-L04-S01-A07.effect: Intended to notice and balance patterns of overheating and excess activity.

RY-L04-S01-A08.title: Dampness
RY-L04-S01-A08.effect: Intended to observe stagnation and accumulation.

RY-L04-S01-A09.title: Dryness
RY-L04-S01-A09.effect: Intended to observe depletion and lack of fluidity.

RY-L04-S01-A10.title: Cold
RY-L04-S01-A10.effect: Intended to notice slowing and lack of warmth.

RY-L04-S01-A11.title: Balancing
RY-L04-S01-A11.description: General balancing of energies and elements.
RY-L04-S01-A11.effect: Intended to bring the system into a more harmonious state.

RY-L04-S02-A01.title: Organ Spirits
RY-L04-S02-A01.description: Working with organ spirits as a symbolic regulatory system.
RY-L04-S02-A01.effect: Intended to strengthen harmony and the perceived vitality of the organs.

RY-L04-S02-A02.title: Shen
RY-L04-S02-A02.description: The spirit of the Heart in the Chinese source model.
RY-L04-S02-A02.effect: Used to work with the heart centre and a state of clarity.

RY-L04-S02-A03.title: Hun
RY-L04-S02-A03.effect: Intended to strengthen vitality, direction and inner movement.

RY-L04-S02-A04.title: Po
RY-L04-S02-A04.effect: Used symbolically with breathing, boundaries and structure.

RY-L04-S02-A05.title: Zhi
RY-L04-S02-A05.effect: Intended to strengthen will, depth and the sense of vital reserve.

RY-L04-S02-A06.title: Yi
RY-L04-S02-A06.effect: Intended to stabilise thought, nourishment and centredness.

RY-L04-S02-A07.title: Animals of the Organs
RY-L04-S02-A07.description: Working with symbolic power animals associated with the organs.
RY-L04-S02-A07.effect: Intended to strengthen and protect the inner forces represented by the organs.

RY-L04-S02-A08.title: Animals of the Meridians
RY-L04-S02-A08.description: Activation of meridian flow and capacity in the course's energetic model.
RY-L04-S02-A08.effect: Historically described as supporting well-being and energetic conductivity.

RY-L04-S03-A01.title: Bagua
RY-L04-S03-A01.description: Working with Bagua trigrams for personal harmonisation and energy gathering.
RY-L04-S03-A01.effect: Intended to work with events through the symbolic structure of change.

RY-L04-S03-A02.title: Bagua Protection
RY-L04-S03-A02.description: Creating a protective symbolic boundary between the person and the outside world.
RY-L04-S03-A02.effect: Intended to maintain clear energetic boundaries.

RY-L04-S03-A03.title: Trigrams
RY-L04-S03-A03.description: Working with the qualities associated with a selected trigram.
RY-L04-S03-A03.effect: Intended to influence a situation through the chosen symbolic quality.

RY-L04-S03-A04.title: Hexagrams
RY-L04-S03-A04.description: Initiating processes and events through I Ching hexagrams.
RY-L04-S03-A04.effect: Intended to focus attention on desired changes.

RY-L04-S03-A05.title: Circle of Changes
RY-L04-S03-A05.description: Initiating change where it is considered necessary.
RY-L04-S03-A05.effect: Intended to orient practice toward the best available outcome.

RY-L04-S03-A06.title: Zhou Yi Protection
RY-L04-S03-A06.description: A protective practice extended symbolically into past and future.
RY-L04-S03-A06.effect: Intended to strengthen the perceived continuity of an event line through time.

RY-L04-S04-A01.title: Kundalini
RY-L04-S04-A01.description: Activation of Kundalini energy with separate work on chakras and petals.
RY-L04-S04-A01.effect: Intended to release and direct energy within a manageable range.

RY-L04-S04-A02.title: Burning the Implant
RY-L04-S04-A02.description: A source-tradition practice for removing unwanted energetic-information programs.
RY-L04-S04-A02.effect: Intended to clear the field of interfering inclusions.

RY-L04-S04-A03.title: Tattva
RY-L04-S04-A03.description: Attunement to elements and the processes they symbolically initiate in body and consciousness.
RY-L04-S04-A03.effect: Intended to deepen body-focused practice through elemental symbolism.

RY-L04-S04-A04.title: Gods
RY-L04-S04-A04.description: Attunement to archetypal forces associated with chakras and masculine/feminine principles.
RY-L04-S04-A04.effect: Intended to bring archetypal support and balance into the practice.

RY-L04-S05-A01.title: Money Magic 1
RY-L04-S05-A01.effect: Intended to improve awareness of resource movement.

RY-L04-S05-A02.title: Money Magic 2
RY-L04-S05-A02.description: Observing money movement, financial connections and attraction patterns.
RY-L04-S05-A02.effect: Intended to make relationships and movement within financial flow more visible.

RY-L04-S05-A03.title: Money Magic 3
RY-L04-S05-A03.description: Working with changes in the amount of money.
RY-L04-S05-A03.effect: Intended to explore mechanisms of growth and change in financial resource.
